name: URL Parser
description: Parse a URL locally into protocol, hostname, port, pathname, query parameters and fragment.
search_intent: Break a URL into its individual components and query parameters.
calculation: Use standards-based URL parsing locally in the browser or a deterministic equivalent. Extract protocol, hostname, explicit/effective port where appropriate, pathname, query string, fragment and query parameters. Preserve repeated query parameter keys. Malformed or unsupported input must return a clear validation result rather than throwing.
limitations: Parsing a URL does not verify that the host or resource exists.
The tool makes no request to the entered URL.
Relative URLs require an explicit base URL and should not be silently interpreted as absolute URLs.
